Television Terror Triple Feature Pizza Party 2

1960s, 70s, and 80s
300min
Buy Tickets
  • Sunday, Oct 18, 2026, 4:30pm

Screening location: SIFF Film Center – 167 Republican St, Seattle (located within the Seattle Center, just north of Climate Pledge Arena / east of KEXP and The Vera Project)

We invite you once again to make the theater your living room for another trip back in time to the heyday of made-for-TV horror movies.

For this year's triple feature pizza party, we're broadcasting three more chilling tales straight from 1960s, 70s, and 80s network TV, when original horror movies haunted home television screens on a regular basis. The evening's program consists of another trio of lesser-known gems, this time featuring creepy phone calls, stalkers, highway horror, and mysterious items of the occult. As always, the titles are secret, so you won't find out what frightening fables are in store for you until airtime.
